description_text:
High-quality, photorealistic 3D model of a Modern Indoor Kids Playground / Soft Play Area. This premium commercial interior asset is production-ready and meticulously optimized for professional architectural visualization (ArchViz), shopping mall entertainment zones, family restaurant play corners, kindergarten designs, and hotel kids' club staging.
The model showcases detailed modular play structures, safety padding, slides, a ball pit pool, and interactive maze crawl-through tunnels, rendering flawlessly from both long-distance and close-up angles.
Originally created with 3ds Max 2014, this asset guarantees professional-grade, clean geometry, correct scene organization, and flawless texture mapping. Built to an accurate 1:1 real-world scale (mm) and perfectly centered at the origin coordinates (0,0,0) for effortless drag-and-drop integration.

  - Geometry: 111,972 polygons / 117,596 vertices — perfectly balanced for smooth rendering performance and high-fidelity interior visualization.

  - UV Mapping: Professionally unwrapped UVs, manually layout with mixed mapping options.

  - Textures & Materials: High-resolution bright plastic, foam, soft fabric, and mesh PBR texture maps included. Fully configured with high-fidelity Corona Render shaders.

  - Native Format: 3ds Max 2015 (fully configured with high-fidelity Corona Render shaders).

  - Universal Exchange Formats: OBJ (2 files) and FBX with completely stripped texture paths.

  - Clean Asset: No external third-party scripts or plugins required to open and render the scene.

Hope you like it! If you are satisfied with this 3D model, please leave a positive feedback. Thank you!

description_text:

La única arma cuerpo a cuerpo revelada hasta ahora. Es un arma tipo katana que generalmente está en un estado cerrado de solo empuñadura. Cuando está en uso, una cuchilla increíblemente afilada se extiende desde la empuñadura. Puede extenderse sin pérdida de durabilidad y se desconoce si su longitud es limitada; actualmente solo se ha extendido a aproximadamente 30 pies. Las espadas se ven esparcidas por el suelo en la misma habitación que las Monobikes, que solo se desbloquea después de que se abre la bola de Gantz. Ninguno de los miembros actuales del equipo de Tokyo Gantz sabía de esto hasta que Izumi apareció antes de la misión Dinosaur. Después de esa misión, otros también se muestran con espadas. La espada Gantz se puede usar en modo sigiloso, incluso cuando está al alcance máximo. La única vez que se muestra que la espada se rompe es durante la misión de Italia cuando Kurono y Kato la usan para atacar a dos extraterrestres de la estatua romana.

description_text:
The Witcher wolf medallion from The witcher's saga ready to print and render with high resolution texture (videogame-accurate)
Include: 

  - 
High Poly STL for Printing

  - 
Blender file for Render  - 
7 High Resolution Texture (2K) Base Color, Normal, Height, Utility(Channel R for roughness, Channel G for Metalness, Channel B for Ambient Occlusion), and Emissive

  - Low poly OBJ

  - Low poly STL

  - Low poly FBX

A witcher medallion is a silver symbol of the witchers' profession. Each one is shaped to represent the school a witcher comes from. It is sensitive to magic, vibrating and tugging on its chain when spells are being cast or magical beings, like genies or even mages, are present. This magic medallion is given to every young witcher candidate who has passed the Trial of the Grasses. The origin of the first medallions is unknown, though it is assumed they were made in the magic forge at Kaer Morhen. The medallions vibrate in response to magic in all its forms, including curses, charms, and spells. They also warn of lurking monsters born of magic or magic experimentation.The witcher medallion is not only an insignia of our profession, it is also one of its tools. It has numerous useful capabilities that are accessible, of course, only to one who possesses the necessary knowledge and training. First of all, it reacts to the presence of sorcerous auras in the immediate surroundings, making us aware of nearby spellcasting, active illusions, or magical creatures. It also warns the owner of sudden dangers, thus providing an additional moment to react. Keep in mind, though, that the medallion is not infallible. A very strong magical aura, such as those found in Places of Power or during the solstices, can provoke aberrant reactions. In large cities, where people widely use simple magical amulets or sorcerous alarm systems to protect their homes, coin, or ruttish wives, the medallion can also behave abnormally.

[B]Venus at Bath[/B]
The Venus at Bath was commissioned in 1756 and completed c. 1767. Its concept, derived loosely from Giambologna, is much better than the execution, whereby the goddess remains lumpish and her draperies inert and mechanical. However, it was praised by Diderot. This appealed to Madame Du Barry, who obtained the Venus and placed it at Louveciennes, and commissioned in 1772 from the sculptor a pendant of virtually the same subject in less languorous mood: a Diana surprised by Actaeon (also in the Louvre, Paris), completed five years later and then exhibited in the artist's studio.

The Renault FT, frequently referred to in post-World War I literature as the "FT-17" or "FT17", was a French light tank that was among the most revolutionary and influential tank designs in history. The FT was the first production tank to have its armament within a fully rotating turret.[note 1] The Renault FT's configuration – crew compartment at the front, engine compartment at the back, and main armament in a revolving turret – became and remains the standard tank layout. Over 3,000 Renault FT tanks were manufactured by French industry, most of them during the year 1918. Another 950 of an almost identical licensed copy of the FT (the M1917) were made in the United States, but not in time to enter combat. Armoured warfare historian Steven Zaloga has called the Renault FT "the world's first modern tank.
